crossRefs.note: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
Behold, the Lord Yahweh will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and…
“I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to…
therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.
You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”
He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God: and they…
Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest, in the middle of…
Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for…
You will also be a crown of beauty in Yahweh‘s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.
In that day, says Yahweh of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says Yahweh, ‘and…
Yahweh of Armies says: “In those days, ten men will take hold, out of all the languages of the nations, they will take…
It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his…
Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at…
At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all…

translations.web: Yahweh their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
translations.bsb: On that day the LORD their God will save them as the flock of His people; for like jewels in a crown they will sparkle over His land.
translations.kjv: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
translations.asv: And Jehovah their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
